steps.eval: (() => { const cands = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => { const s = getComputedStyle(el); return (s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 40; }); window.__scrollers = cands; const target = cands.find(el => el.contains(document.getElementById('preview-root'))) || cands[0]; if (!target) return false; window.__scroller = target; target.scrollTop = target.scrollHeight * 0.45; return true; })()
(() => { if (!window.__scroller) return false; window.__scroller.scrollTop = window.__scroller.scrollHeight * 0.8; return true; })()
